authority: Philco 1941 RMS Year Book, printed p. 38 PT-42/PT-44 schematic and p. 36 specifications; Sylvania 1953 7C6 data for internal cathode bond only.

open_items.gap: Review of the p.38 RF/converter region is recorded, but no new RF memberships were added. Source-to-functional-terminal mapping for the 7A8, aerial/loop/oscillator windings, tuning gangs and compensators remains open.
The three currently represented #12/#14 plate/grid groups were source-checked. Complete winding endpoints, 7B7 screen/cathode, trimmers and AVC connections remain open.

The four detector/audio groups and upper-diode symbol-level link were rechecked. The diode glyph is still not assigned to a socket pin; #17 lower branch, 7C6 external cathode return and full AVC routing remain open.
The 7C6 plate, 50L6 grid/cathode, #26 primary and #26/#27 secondary memberships are source-checked. #22/#25 routes, winding characteristics and speaker/model correlation remain open.

The filter/return groups, four internal heater-chain links and #30 40 Ω/lamp shunt groups were source-checked. Trace both mains paths, #16 switch, 35Z3 anode, #31 line capacitor and the complete heater endpoints before claiming a complete AC network.

The 22 currently represented net groups and 54 listed terminal memberships received a native 300-dpi page-38 cross-check. RF has no transcribed net groups; socket/winding crosswalks and unrepresented factory connections remain open.
Replace reduced-order model with validated tube, transformer and passive SPICE models.

completion_gates.title: Complete source-traced, pin-level PT-44 netlist
completion_gates.acceptance: Every factory component, external tube terminal, winding end, switch contact and return has a source-backed connection or an explicit manufacturer option.

completion_gates.title: Schematic-to-chassis crosswalk
completion_gates.acceptance: Physical component locations and lead dress are cross-checked against adequate chassis evidence; electrical membership remains the authority.

completion_gates.title: Service measurements have defined test conditions
completion_gates.acceptance: Return reference, instrument loading, operating state and tolerances are verified before factory voltages are used as pass/fail targets.

completion_gates.title: Full receiver behavior correlates to source data
completion_gates.acceptance: Power, heater, RF, IF, detector, AVC and audio operating behavior is validated against service references and independent calculations.

completion_gates.title: Full SPICE model is validated
completion_gates.acceptance: Sourced tube and transformer models, passive values and operating states reproduce documented circuit behavior; the isolated RC deck alone does not satisfy this gate.

completion_gates.title: Repair and fault regressions remain stable
completion_gates.acceptance: Known fault cases remain diagnosable and repairable through the shop workflow after the engineering model is connected to gameplay.

latest_evidence_update: Five v0.29–v0.33 source-review milestones checked all 22 currently represented graph groups (54 listed memberships) against the Philco page-38 scan; v0.29 confirms #26:a. RF memberships and several endpoint/pin crosswalks remain open.
